summary: Learn risk-based controls for project funds, procurement, sub-grants and reporting. Build practical assurance tools in this five-day course.
lede: Internal control training for donor-funded projects equips finance, grant and audit teams to assess controls and document evidence across project spending. Participants practise mapping risks to control owners, checking payment and procurement records, monitoring sub-grants, and tracking exceptions in Excel. They also prepare reconciliations and audit evidence using COSO and ISO 31000 as reference points, adapting controls to the relevant donor agreement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for financial accountability, procurement assurance, partner oversight or results reporting on donor-funded projects. It suits practitioners who need to apply internal controls in routine project operations and managers who review control evidence.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with project accounting, organizational finance or grant-funded programme operations is recommended. You should be able to read basic budgets, payment records or grant reporting documents. No programming is required.
